title: Focused replies
description: Tap a quoted reply or Show replies to open its native thread, including ancestors outside the cached timeline and nested replies. The parent stays mounted. Loading, partial and unavailable context are explicit; no original message is invented.

title: Separate reply draft
description: A focused thread keeps its own draft and exact reply target. Returning preserves the parent draft and reading place; reopening restores the thread draft. Text, photos and voice use the same native target.

title: Replies: failure and retry
description: A failed thread request stays in the child view with Retry and Back to conversation. A successful retry restores actual context. These captures deliberately inject one refusal into the isolated DEMO.

title: Eligible message actions
description: Edit and Undo Send appear only for your server-qualified iMessages within their allowed time and edit count. Expired or unverifiable actions are hidden. The menu wraps on the cover.

title: Edit a bubble
description: Edit the selected message inline, with Save and Cancel. The unsent conversation draft stays independent. The original bubble changes after a confirming server update, rather than treating transport acceptance as delivery.

title: Available edit history
description: Tap Edited to review available earlier versions and the current text. A partial-history notice identifies missing versions; unavailable text is never invented. Five edits and restart persistence were also exercised in a separate native DEMO walk.

title: Edit: keep the rejected draft
description: If the Mac refuses a change, keep the typed edit and old sent bubble. Show one persistent inline error, then let the owner retry or cancel. This DEMO retry is checked against exact server text and edit count.

title: Undo Send notice
description: A confirmed unsent fact replaces that message with a notice and clears its cached text, media, reactions and quoted content. A stale history page cannot resurrect it. Existing ordinary deletion remains separate. Recipient behavior is not established by this DEMO.

title: Search the full conversation
description: Find messages through the Mac’s full-history search, including outside the first 50 cached messages. Highlight matching snippet text; show More results while a server scan is incomplete. Find dismisses the keyboard.

title: Open an exact match
description: Open a result at its exact native message ID with surrounding context. Previous/next matches and Earlier/Later context preserve the search. Returning keeps the parent draft and reading place. Context paging does not count as a new arrival or splice a gap into the main timeline.

title: No results and clear
description: Only a completed server scan can say No results. Clear returns to the initial search field; empty partial scans retain a More results action. Unicode-safe snippets and an emoji/accented-text result are checked separately.

title: Search: failure and retry
description: A refused search keeps the query, shows Retry and offers Done searching. Retrying fetches actual server results. Neither failure nor successful retry consumes the parent draft.

title: Search · unfolded
description: The unfolded size of the same full-history search. This is the existing conversation’s search flow, not another feature or a separate preference state.

title: Replies · unfolded
description: The unfolded size of the same focused Replies pane and its separate saved draft. Returning restores the existing conversation workspace and Shared pane.
